people.name: Jean-Noël Alexandre Robert
people.field: orientalist, specialist of the history of Buddhism in Japan and of its Chinese predecessors

relations.subject: Jean-Noël Alexandre Robert
relations.object: Institut national des langues et civilisations orientales
relations.evidence: Robert graduated from the Institut national des langues et civilisations orientales in 1970

relations.subject: Jean-Noël Alexandre Robert
relations.evidence: was a resident of the Franco-Japanese House of Tokyo in 1974–1975

relations.subject: Jean-Noël Alexandre Robert
relations.object: French National Centre for Scientific Research
relations.evidence: From 1975 to 1990, he worked at the French National Centre for Scientific Research.

relations.subject: Jean-Noël Alexandre Robert
relations.evidence: Since 1979, he has been the lecturer and director of studies at the fifth section of the École pratique des hautes études (EPHE).

relations.subject: Jean-Noël Alexandre Robert
relations.object: Institut des hautes études japonaises des Instituts d’Asie of the Collège de France
relations.evidence: he was appointed director of the Institut des hautes études japonaises des Instituts d’Asie of the Collège de France in 2010.

relations.subject: Jean-Noël Alexandre Robert
relations.evidence: On 11 April 2011, he was appointed professor at the College of France where he became holder of the Chair of Philologie de la civilisation japonaise.

relations.subject: Jean-Noël Alexandre Robert
relations.evidence: He was elected on 17 March 2006, member of the Académie des Inscriptions et Belles-Lettres at the chair of André Caquot.
